note: The three arms of doc 64's pilot (2026-09-28), in run order. 'gguf' is relative to --models-dir or RWM_MODELS_DIR, laid out as <repo>/<file>; to use other locations, copy this file to arms.local.json (git-ignored), which the driver prefers. repo, revision, size and sha256 match tools/local-qual/presets/drafts. Sampler rule (design.json prompting.sampler): temperature 0.6 for every model; each vendor's non-thinking top_p/top_k/min_p; a value the vendor does not give is disabled (top_p 1.0, top_k 0, min_p 0). 'resume' was true for Qwen because an earlier run of that arm was interrupted; on a fresh output folder it changes nothing. 'label' is the model name recorded in every run header, and --resume refuses a file with another.
